elements.name: Verify that user can register successfully

the user clicks on the Signup and Login link

the user clicks the Signup button

the user clicks Create Account
the "ACCOUNT CREATED!" message appears

the products list is displayed

the product details match the selected product

no products are listed

name: Products
description:
As a visitor
  I want to browse and search products
  So that I can find what I want to buy

elements.name: Verify that user can add products to cart and complete checkout

steps.name: a registered user exists
the user is on the home page
the user is logged in
the user opens the Products page
the user hovers over a product and clicks Add to Cart
the product added message is displayed
the user opens the cart from the confirmation
the cart contains the added product
the user proceeds to checkout
the user validates the delivery address and order review
the user enters an order comment and clicks Place Order
the user enters valid payment details and confirms the order
the order confirmation "Your order has been placed successfully!" is displayed
a registered user exists
the user is on the home page
the user is logged in
the user opens the cart
the cart is empty
the Proceed To Checkout option is not available
